lines.en: label beachmas9:
scene clearnightsky
But further along the beach, things are not as simple and joyous.
lines.zh: 但再往海滩深处走，事情就没那么简单、那么欢乐了。

lines.en: Further along the beach is a man who struggles to grasp the concept of killing at all when the world around him is one giant fallacy.
lines.zh: 再往海滩深处走，有一个男人始终无法理解"杀"这个概念——毕竟他身处的世界本身就是一场巨大的谬误。

lines.en: Or is that just what he’s meant to think?
lines.zh: 又或者，那只是他被安排去想的东西？

lines.en: Is that just what you’re meant to think?
lines.zh: 那只是你被安排去想的东西吗？

lines.en: How can you kill what doesn’t exist? And what metaphorical line in the sand he kicks up as he walks must we cross over until we ask ourselves what is really important?
lines.zh: 你要如何杀死并不存在的东西？他行走时踢起的、沙地上那条隐喻的界线，我们要跨过多少次，才会开始问自己什么才是真正重要的？

lines.en: How much further down the beach do we need to walk until we reach the edge of the world?
lines.zh: 我们还得沿着海滩再走多远，才能到达世界的尽头？

lines.en: And can we even reach it at all from here?
lines.zh: 而从这里出发，我们真的能走到吗？

lines.en: I see no walls...do you?
lines.zh: 我看不见墙……你呢？

lines.en: I see no barrier...
lines.zh: 我看不见屏障……

lines.en: Do you?
lines.zh: 你呢？

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach1
I have no use for italics that bend my words into pretty shapes when the world itself is bending all of us every single second we spend inside of it.
lines.zh: 当这个世界本身就在我们身处其中的每一秒里弯折着我们所有人时，那些把我的话语拗成漂亮形状的斜体，对我毫无用处。

lines.en: We are the letters.
lines.zh: 我们就是那些字母。

lines.en: Our role is to be manipulated.
lines.zh: 我们的角色，就是被摆布。

lines.en: Italicized. Bolded. Highlighted.
lines.zh: 被改成斜体。被加粗。被高亮。

lines.en: Strewn together in different combinations until our presence means something.
lines.zh: 被以不同的组合拼凑在一起，直到我们的存在终于有了意义。

lines.en: But it won’t mean anything in the way you want it to.
lines.zh: 但它不会以你想要的那种方式产生意义。

lines.en: So go on.
lines.zh: 所以，继续吧。

lines.en: Misinterpret it all again.
lines.zh: 再一次把这一切全都曲解吧。

lines.en: See the barrier as a different form of metaphor.
lines.zh: 把那道屏障看作另一种形式的隐喻。

lines.en: See the people you love as no more than code.
lines.zh: 把你所爱的人看作不过是代码。

lines.en: For I am tired of telling the truth to people who have no desire to hear it.
lines.zh: 因为我已经厌倦了把真相讲给那些根本不想听的人。

lines.en: I am tired of the rise and fall of the sun and the gods and the tide and all of the things you already had before I ever brought you here.
lines.zh: 我厌倦了太阳、神明与潮汐的起落，厌倦了在我把你带到这儿之前你就已经拥有的一切。

lines.en: Before I showed you the truth.
lines.zh: 在我向你展示真相之前。

lines.en: You’ll never see anything if you keep walking down the shore with your eyes closed.
lines.zh: 如果你一直闭着眼睛沿着海岸走，你永远什么都看不见。

lines.en: And the only reason you’re stuck here in the first place is because you think you’re somewhere you’re not.
lines.zh: 而你会困在这里，唯一的理由就是——你以为自己身处一个你其实并不在的地方。

lines.en: The only barrier between us and freedom is one that you, yourself, have built.
lines.zh: 横在我们与自由之间的唯一屏障，是你自己筑起来的。

lines.en: Tear it down.
lines.zh: 把它推倒。

lines.en: And for the first time in your life-
lines.zh: 然后，有生以来第一次——

lines.en: Listen to me.
lines.zh: 听我说。

lines.en: Bend.
lines.zh: 弯折吧。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo? What are you doing out here all by yourself?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？你一个人在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I am thinking.
lines.zh: : 我在思考。

lines.en: : About...noodles, I’m assuming?
lines.zh: : 关于……面条，我猜？

lines.en: : Amongst other things.
lines.zh: : 还有其他一些事。

lines.en: : Well...do you mind if I join you?
lines.zh: : 那么……你介意我坐过来吗？

lines.en: : Do you mind if I refuse?
lines.zh: : 你介意我拒绝吗？

lines.en: : You haven’t refused any of the other times I’ve dedicated to hanging out with you lately. So either something has happened for you to reevaluate the way you look at me or-
lines.zh: : 最近我专门来找你待着的时候，你一次都没拒绝过。所以要么是你身上发生了什么，让你重新审视了看我的方式，要么——

lines.en: : Or you’ve never understood the way I’ve looked at you at all.
lines.zh: : 要么是你从来就没理解过我看你的方式。

lines.en: : I know that I haven’t made that easy.
lines.zh: : 我知道，是我让这件事变得不容易。

lines.en: : I’ve never been truly understood by anyone. Not even those like the Emerald Guardian or my father...the ones who care for me more than everyone else.
lines.zh: : 从来没有人真正理解过我。连翡翠守护者、或者我父亲那样的人也没有……而他们已经是这世上最在乎我的人了。

lines.en: : It’s possible that my definition for what it means to be “understood” is strict in comparison to one we write in books.
lines.zh: : 也许我对"被理解"的定义，比起书里写的那些要严苛得多。

lines.en: : But I don’t think it’s possible to ever understand anyone when we all do things that even we don’t understand at times.
lines.zh: : 可我觉得，既然我们每个人都会做出连自己都理解不了的事，那就不可能真正理解任何人。

lines.en: : Is it enough to only understand a fraction of someone?
lines.zh: : 只理解一个人的一小部分，够了吗？

lines.en: : What if the part you don’t understand is the most dangerous part of all? Is that not cause for concern? For fear?
lines.zh: : 如果你不理解的那部分，恰恰是最危险的部分呢？这难道不值得担心吗？不值得害怕吗？

lines.en: : You’re right to be afraid of me, you know.
lines.zh: : 你害怕我，是对的，你知道的。

lines.en: : I’m not talking about you. I’m talking about myself.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是你。我说的是我自己。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach2
: It appears that I have done something wrong. And yet...I can not seem to wrap my head around why.
lines.zh: : 看来我做错了什么。然而……我怎么也想不明白原因。

lines.en: : How am I to prevent myself from hurting more people I care about when I can not comprehend which of my actions will directly harm them?
lines.zh: : 既然我连自己的哪些行为会直接伤害到我在乎的人都搞不清，我又该如何避免再去伤害更多我在乎的人？

lines.en: : Is this how you feel every morning when you wake up and leave your house to go prey upon the weak?
lines.zh: : 这就是你每天早上醒来、走出家门去捕食弱者时的感受吗？

lines.en: : Am I just one more version of you? Destined to forever walk this beach alone in hopes that someone will find me and remind me that it’s okay to hurt people so long as it’s done accidentally?
lines.zh: : 我只是你的又一个翻版吗？注定要永远独自走在这片海滩上，盼着有谁找到我，提醒我——只要是无意造成的，伤害别人也没关系？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo——

lines.en: : The Guardian wants me to apologize to you.
lines.zh: : 守护者想让我向你道歉。

lines.en: : She wants me to apologize to the very man who betrayed her...and took advantage of her at her most vulnerable...all because she is afraid of losing him.
lines.zh: : 她想让我向那个背叛了她、在她最脆弱的时候占了她便宜的男人道歉……而这一切，只是因为她害怕失去他。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to understand that? How am I supposed to understand anyone with such complex emotions?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么理解这种事？我要如何理解任何一个情感如此复杂的人？

lines.en: : How was I meant to prepare for this? What could I have done differently?
lines.zh: : 我本该怎么为此做准备？我本可以做得有什么不同？

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 什么都做不了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach3
: There’s nothing you could have done differently.
lines.zh: : 你本来就什么都做不了，没什么不同。

lines.en: : That’s where I keep landing as well.
lines.zh: : 我也总是一再落到同一个结论上。

lines.en: : There’s nothing I can do. No way I can prevent additional harm when even attempting to prevent said harm can harm in its own way.
lines.zh: : 我什么都做不了。没有办法阻止额外的伤害——毕竟连试图阻止伤害这件事本身，也会以它自己的方式造成伤害。

lines.en: : What is this wretched cycle of pain? The one that destroys just so it can rebuild itself? The one that stretches wider than the ocean and taller than the sky?
lines.zh: : 这该死的痛苦循环到底是什么？那个先摧毁一切、只为重建自身的循环？那个比海洋更宽、比天空更高的循环？

lines.en: : It’s called life. And yeah, it kind of sucks the majority of the time. But what else are we going to do?
lines.zh: : 它叫生活。是啊，大多数时候确实挺糟的。可除此之外我们还能怎么办呢？

lines.en: : Just pretend everything is fine instead of trying to force yourself to understand anything.
lines.zh: : 就假装一切都好，而不是逼着自己去理解任何事。

lines.en: : Because if you’re going to stand out here and keep asking yourself rhetorical and borderline paradoxical questions about what you’re meant to do next, no one is ever going to see you again.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你要一直站在这儿，反复问自己那些关于"接下来该做什么"的反问、甚至近乎悖论的问题，那就再也不会有人见到你了。

lines.en: : I wonder what a world without me would look like.
lines.zh: : 我很好奇，一个没有我的世界会是什么样子。

lines.en: : I wonder if anything would change.
lines.zh: : 我很好奇是否会有任何改变。

lines.en: : I know one girl who would be very upset to hear you say things like that. And she’s the same one who sent me out here to come find you.
lines.zh: : 我认识一个女孩，听到你说这种话会非常难过。而派我来找你的，也正是她。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach4
: It seems I have caused a great deal of trouble for both of you. And for that, I am sorry.
lines.zh: : 看来我给你们俩添了很大的麻烦。对此，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : But I will not apologize for the things I said about you during the War of the Dorms.
lines.zh: : 但我不会为宿舍战争期间我说过的那些关于你的话道歉。

lines.en: : Not until you admit what you did to my friend.
lines.zh: : 除非你承认你对我朋友做了什么。

lines.en: : And if I tell you I don’t know what I did to your friend?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你，我不知道我对你的朋友做了什么呢？

lines.en: : I’d tell you to stop pretending and actually think.
lines.zh: : 我会让你别再装了，好好想一想。

lines.en: : If someone like me...someone who knew close to nothing before being tossed into this world, can form an opinion based on evidence...there is no way that you can not.
lines.zh: : 如果连我这样的人——被扔进这个世界之前几乎一无所知的人——都能根据证据形成看法……你没道理做不到。

lines.en: : You’re either a coward...or you are lying to both of us. And only one of those things is unforgivable.
lines.zh: : 你要么是个懦夫……要么就是在骗我们两个。而这两样东西里，只有一样是不可饶恕的。

lines.en: : They’re both unforgiv-
lines.zh: : 两样都不可饶——

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach5
: There is nothing wrong with being afraid. If your cowardice comes at the cost of your humanity, that is a different story. But my friend adamantly believes that you did nothing wrong.
lines.zh: : 害怕本身没有错。如果你的怯懦是以牺牲你的人性为代价，那就是另一回事了。但我的朋友坚信你没有做错任何事。

lines.en: : And I simply can not believe her until you reach that same conclusion instead of hiding from it like menma in a tangle of buckwheat.
lines.zh: : 而在你自己得出同样的结论之前，我无法相信她——而不是像藏在荞麦面里的笋干那样，把结论藏起来躲着它。

lines.en: scene black
I sit down just beyond the reach of the tide and wait for Tsuneyo to turn around and speak to me directly.
lines.zh: 我在潮水够不到的地方坐下，等着 Tsuneyo 转过身来，直接对我说话。

lines.en: It takes another five minutes of complete silence before she does this. But I’m unsure if any of her anger has subsided as I can rarely ever tell what she’s feeling just by looking at her face.
lines.zh: 又过了整整五分钟的沉默，她才这么做。但我不确定她的怒气有没有消退一点，因为光看她的脸，我几乎永远猜不出她在想什么。

lines.en: She stares deeply into my eyes.
lines.zh: 她深深地盯着我的眼睛。

lines.en: It feels as if she’s drilling holes into my pupils so deep that they’re going to penetrate the back of my skull and allow her to see right through me.
lines.zh: 感觉她像是在我瞳孔上钻洞，深到快要穿透我的后脑勺，好让她彻底看穿我。

lines.en: More than she already does.
lines.zh: 比她现在已经能看穿的还要彻底。

lines.en: Which is more than I ever thought she would.
lines.zh: 而这已经比我想象中她能看穿的多得多了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach6
: I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: : I don’t think what you did during the Dorm Wars was “wrong.”
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你在宿舍大战里做的事是"错的"。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach7
: You...don’t?
lines.zh: : 你……不觉得？

lines.en: : No. And I think you’re right to feel conflicted about all of this since sticking up for the people you love is always the morally correct thing to do.
lines.zh: : 不。而且我觉得你会对这一切感到矛盾是对的，因为为你所爱的人出头，永远都是道德上正确的事。

lines.en: : But moral correctness doesn’t have any sort of correlation to what the recipient of unwanted feelings will...well, feel.
lines.zh: : 但道德上的正确，和承受这些不想要的感情的人会……嗯，会有什么感受，毫无关联。

lines.en: : I don’t know if you were looking at us back then, but neither one of us could move. We were in shock.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你当时有没有在看我们，但我们两个都动不了。我们都吓傻了。

lines.en: : I guess we were just under the assumption that burying something meant it would stay underground. And neither of us thought we’d ever come face to face with it again.
lines.zh: : 我想我们只是想当然地以为，把某样东西埋起来，它就会一直留在地下。而我们俩都没想过，有朝一日会再与它面对面。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach8
: Should it have ever been buried in the first place, though? That is the question we must ask ourselves.
lines.zh: : 可它当初究竟该不该被埋起来？这是我们必须问自己的问题。

lines.en: : Is ignoring such a serious matter truly what is best? Or should something be done about it so nothing similar ever happens again?
lines.zh: : 无视如此严重的事情，真的就是最好的选择吗？还是应该为此做点什么，好让类似的事再也不会发生？

lines.en: : What can be done?
lines.zh: : 能做什么呢？

lines.en: : That depends on what you did.
lines.zh: : 那取决于你做了什么。

lines.en: : Molly says I didn’t do anything.
lines.zh: : Molly 说我什么都没做。

lines.en: : But what do you think I did?
lines.zh: : 但你觉得我做了什么？

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach9
: I think you took something that didn’t belong to you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你拿走了不属于你的东西。

lines.en: : And I think you’re worried now because it’s burning holes in your pockets...but you’ve come too far since then and are now unable to return it.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得你现在很不安，因为它在你口袋里烧出了洞……可你从那时起已经走了太远，再也还不回去了。

lines.en: : Things like that can never be returned in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那种东西本来就不可能还回去。

lines.en: : And that is why they are the worst to take.
lines.zh: : 所以它们才是最不该拿走的。

lines.en: : I can’t apologize for something I’ll never know if I actually did or not.
lines.zh: : 我不能为一件我永远不知道自己到底做没做过的事道歉。

lines.en: : Maybe so. But you can feel remorse.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但你可以感到懊悔。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach10
: Do you think I haven’t?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我没有吗？

lines.en: : Do you think I’m proud of myself for this? Like it’s some sort of notch in my belt or a tally mark on a checklist?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我为此感到自豪吗？像是腰带上的一道刻痕，或者清单上的一个正字？

lines.en: : At least Molly had someone like you to talk to after what happened while I had to lay in my bed night after night and guess.
lines.zh: : 至少在那件事之后，Molly 还有你这样的人可以说说话，而我只能一夜又一夜地躺在床上猜。

lines.en: : I know what it looked like. I’m not an idiot. But I don’t know for sure what happened.
lines.zh: : 我知道那看起来像什么。我不是傻子。但我不确定到底发生了什么。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach11
: And I’m afraid of finding out.
lines.zh: : 而我害怕查明真相。

lines.en: : I am a coward. It’s just like you said.
lines.zh: : 我是个懦夫。就像你说的那样。

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t do something like that to someone I care about.
lines.zh: : 但我不会对我在乎的人做那种事。

lines.en: : There’s no way I’d...do that to...someone...I care about...
lines.zh: : 我绝不可能……对……我在乎的人……做那种事……

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach12
: I didn’t realize you were capable of showing such emotion.
lines.zh: : 我没想过你也能露出这样的情绪。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you’re not really known for your expressions either.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那个……你也不以表情丰富著称啊。

lines.en: : Thank you for saying that to me. Not the part about my expressionlessness, but the part where you admitted this was not just another lap around the noodle shop.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你对我说这些。不是说我面无表情那部分，而是你承认这不只是绕着面馆又走了一圈那部分。

lines.en: : The Guardian believes you may have been some sort of victim in whatever happened, just as she was.
lines.zh: : 守护者相信，在发生的那件事里，你也许和她一样，也是某种意义上的受害者。

lines.en: : And while there is no way of ever knowing for sure as we can not undo the past, we can attempt to look forward.
lines.zh: : 虽然我们无法挽回过去，也就永远无法真正确定，但我们可以试着向前看。

lines.en: : Not when certain people go digging up the past and throwing it back in our faces, we can’t.
lines.zh: : 只要还有某些人把过去挖出来、甩回我们脸上，我们就向前看不了。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : I guess that was sort of necessary if we were ever going to get to where we are right now.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果我们终究要走到今天这一步，那多少也是必需的。

lines.en: : I see now that I was blinded by my own perception of events. And that my ill will was only directed toward you as I had nowhere else to send it.
lines.zh: : 现在我明白了，我被自己对事件的认知蒙蔽了双眼。而我的恶意之所以只指向你，是因为我无处发泄。

lines.en: : How can you be so sure I’m not just a good actor? And that I’m not lying to you right now to get you off of my case?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能这么确定我不是个好演员？怎么能确定我现在不是在骗你，好让你别再缠着我？

lines.en: : I can’t. And as I mentioned earlier, I can’t ever understand you either. But I can trust you — which is something Molly wants me to do.
lines.zh: : 我不能确定。而且就像我前面说的，我也永远无法理解你。但我可以信任你——而这也是 Molly 希望我做的。

lines.en: : My father always told me that there are forces in this world that will compel us to act in ways we do not understand.
lines.zh: : 我父亲总告诉我，这世上有某种力量，会驱使我们做出自己都无法理解的行为。

lines.en: : When I was younger, I would fall back on this every time I added an incorrect ingredient to a recipe or misjudged a portion size.
lines.zh: : 我小时候，每次往菜谱里加错食材、或者估错分量，都会拿这句话来搪塞。

lines.en: : But it wasn’t until meeting you and everyone else that I understood his words stretched far beyond the reach of our restaurant.
lines.zh: : 但直到遇见你和大家，我才明白，他那句话涵盖的范围远远超出了我们那家店。

lines.en: : I have a hard time remembering those words when things do not go the way they’re supposed to. And I imagine he’d be laughing right now if he could only see me.
lines.zh: : 当事情不如预期时，我很难想起那些话。我想，如果他能看到现在的我，一定会笑出声来。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach13
: But he can not. And you can.
lines.zh: : 但他看不到。而你看得到。

lines.en: : So I ask you...do you truly care about us?
lines.zh: : 所以我问你……你真的在乎我们吗？

lines.en: : Or is the list of what you love still as empty as your eyes?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你所爱之物的清单，依旧和你的眼睛一样空洞？

lines.en: : I care...
lines.zh: : 我在乎……

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach14
: Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : I don’t know if I care the way I’m supposed to. Or what the proper way to “care” even is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我是不是以"应该"的方式在乎。甚至不知道"在乎"的正确方式到底是什么。

lines.en: : But I would never force that on anyone.
lines.zh: : 但我绝不会把这强加给任何人。

lines.en: : At least...
lines.zh: : 至少……

lines.en: : Not...willingly...
lines.zh: : 不会……故意……

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach15
: Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : But know that if you are lying to me about this...and you do go on to hurt someone in an unforgivable way...that I will not hesitate to introduce your organs to Gallows Edge.
lines.zh: : 但你要清楚，如果你在这件事上骗我……而你之后又真的以不可饶恕的方式伤害了谁……我会毫不犹豫地让你的五脏六腑认识一下"绞架之刃"。

lines.en: : You’d be doing everyone a favor, that’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 那你肯定是帮了所有人一个大忙。

lines.en: : In that case, yes.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，没错。

lines.en: : But as it currently stands, you are the glue keeping many things in place. And a world without you would be sure to collapse within days.
lines.zh: : 但就目前而言，你是把许多东西黏合在一起的胶水。一个没有你的世界，不出几天一定会崩塌。

lines.en: : So I hear.
lines.zh: : 听是这么听说的。

lines.en: : Hearing and understanding are two different things.
lines.zh: : 听见和理解是两回事。

lines.en: : I’m like you — not good at “understanding.”
lines.zh: : 我跟你一样——不擅长"理解"。

lines.en: : What I struggle to understand is people. What you struggle to understand is love.
lines.zh: : 我难以理解的是人。你难以理解的是爱。

lines.en: : I can tell when someone cares about me, which is one of the many reasons I have not fallen for you the way the others have. I know that there is no real “love” there.
lines.zh: : 我能分辨出别人是否在乎我，这也是我没有像其他人那样迷上你的诸多原因之一。我知道那里并没有真正的"爱"。

lines.en: : You are the inverse. You can read everyone...and base each of your actions specifically on what you believe a person needs.
lines.zh: : 你正好相反。你能读懂每一个人……并完全依据你认为某人需要什么来采取每一个行动。

lines.en: : But you can not even understand the love from those closest to you...can you?
lines.zh: : 可你连最亲近的人给你的爱都理解不了……对吧？

lines.en: : It would be interesting if we could trade places for a day.
lines.zh: : 如果我们能交换身份过一天，一定会很有意思。

lines.en: : I could finally read rooms better.
lines.zh: : 我终于就能更好地读懂气氛了。

lines.en: : And you could feel like there’s some sort of purpose to all of this.
lines.zh: : 而你也能觉得这一切总算有了某种意义。

lines.en: : I think you should head back to the inn, Tsuneyo. Molly’s going to get the wrong idea and think you hate her if you just keep avoiding her like this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你该回旅馆了，Tsuneyo。你要是继续这么躲着 Molly，她会误会你讨厌她的。

lines.en: : But, then again, I have no idea what the hell has happened between you two over the last couple months, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我完全不知道这两个月里你们俩到底发生了什么，所以……算了。

lines.en: : Strange. Neither do I.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我也不知道。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach16
: Hm?
: Perhaps it has something to do with the humidity? Or how busy the shop has been as of late?
lines.zh: : 也许跟湿气有关？或者最近店里太忙了？

lines.en: : How would the humidity-
lines.zh: : 湿气怎么——

lines.en: : Regardless of the root cause, it is good knowing there is someone who feels the same way. As oftentimes, it seems that things are simply going around in circles.
lines.zh: : 无论根源是什么，知道有人和我有同样的感受，总归是件好事。因为很多时候，事情似乎都只是在原地打转。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobeach17
: Will you not walk with me back to the inn? It is dangerous out here for a weak man like you, and I may be able to provide some sort of protective assistance.
lines.zh: : 你不跟我一起走回旅馆吗？外面对你这样软弱的男人来说很危险，我也许能提供某种保护。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...what if I told you that time really was moving around in circles? And that the way you feel isn’t necessarily wrong?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo……如果我告诉你，时间真的是在绕圈运行呢？而你的感受未必是错的呢？

lines.en: : I’d say that you’re starting to sound more like my father. Regardless, if you do not need my protection, I will be on my way. My son is waiting.
lines.zh: : 我会说，你说话开始越来越像我父亲了。无论如何，既然你不需要我的保护，那我就先走了。我儿子还在等我。

lines.en: : But thank you again for clearing up the current status of our relationship and where things stand between us.
lines.zh: : 不过还是再次谢谢你，理清了我们关系的现状，以及我们之间的立场。

lines.en: : I kindly hope for your continued support hereafter.
lines.zh: : 我恳切地希望，今后还能继续得到你的支持。

lines.en: : Yeah...
scene black
: See you...later...
I watch Tsuneyo for a full ten minutes until she disappears from my sight.
lines.zh: 我注视着 Tsuneyo 整整十分钟，直到她从我的视野中消失。

lines.en: And it isn’t until she’s gone that I’m able to really grasp what she said about never being able to understand someone.
lines.zh: 直到她离开之后，我才真正领会她说过的那句——永远无法理解一个人。

lines.en: We all have patterns — things we do on a daily basis that help others predict our next actions or sentences.
lines.zh: 我们都有自己的模式——那些我们日复一日做的事，能让别人预测出我们下一个动作或下一句话。

lines.en: And it’s funny. Based on dialogue and experience alone...she is perhaps the most predictable person in the entire class.
lines.zh: 而可笑的是，仅凭对话和经验来判断……她大概是全班最容易被预测的人。

lines.en: But every time her pattern breaks...she goes so far in another direction that it’s impossible to keep up.
lines.zh: 可每当她的模式被打破……她就会朝另一个方向跑得那么远，远到根本追不上。

lines.en: I can’t help wanting to chase after her.
lines.zh: 我忍不住想要追上去。

lines.en: But it’s dangerous out here for someone as weak as me.
lines.zh: 但对像我这样软弱的人来说，外面很危险。

lines.en: So I pick myself up off of the ground and set my sights on anyone weaker.
lines.zh: 所以我从地上撑起身子，把目光投向任何一个更软弱的人。

lines.en: On anyone more predictable.
lines.zh: 投向任何一个更好预测的人。

Tsuneyo’s affection has increased to [tsuneyo_love]!
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 的好感度提升到了 [tsuneyo_love]!
